Initial public release.

Anubis reviews pull requests with a panel of specialist AI reviewers —
`security`, `correctness`, `performance` and `maintainability` — then has a
coordinator validate and deduplicate their findings into one review, posted as a
pull-request comment.

Pin `@v1` to follow releases.

- Configuration: https://github.com/Shenouda-Fawzy/Anubis/blob/main/docs/configuration.md
- Providers and cost: https://github.com/Shenouda-Fawzy/Anubis/blob/main/docs/providers.md
- Security policy: https://github.com/Shenouda-Fawzy/Anubis/blob/main/SECURITY.md
